metadata.summary: Katie Boulter suffered a nightmare US Open exit in a punishing straight sets defeat to Karolina Muchova in under an hour at Flushing Meadows.
metadata.content: US Open 2026: Katie Boulter blown away by Karolina Muchova | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open 2026: Katie Boulter blown away by Karolina Muchova British No 1 broken in every service game and bageled in second set as US Open campaign unravels at hands of Wimbledon finalist Karolina Muchova in under an hour; watch the US Open live on Sky Sports Tennis, streaming service NOW and the Sky Sports app Wednesday 2 September 2026 21:58, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of Katie Boulter against Karolina Muchova from the US Open. Katie Boulter suffered a nightmare US Open exit in a punishing straight sets defeat to Karolina Muchova in under an hour at Flushing Meadows. The British No 1 was broken in all seven of her service games in a chastening 6-1 6-0 defeat inside 58 minutes on Louis Armstrong Stadium. Boulter traded breaks with Muchova at the start of the first set only for the 2026 Wimbledon finalist to pull clear and put on a clinic for her beleaguered opponent. Boulter double faulted eight times and produced 22 unforced errors in a nightmare, error-strewn performance that left her hopes of progressing in tatters.
